findings.explanation: 'FDM4 is set to win as decorators move to one system' is the reference deck's sentence with the names swapped.
FDM4 sits alone in the top-right cell, as if it had no competition; I compete with Ai2000 and ApparelMagic every week.
Aptean is placed 'General ERP' but its own cited quote (e84) calls it an ERP built for the fashion industry.
The thesis leads with decorators, yet no decorator software is on the map; Ai2000 and ApparelMagic, found as candidates, are missing too.
'Help FDM4 grow with outbound sales and AI' is the same help every deck offers, with no gap behind it.
